title: Rewind
status: storyboard reference; first two images also open Exchange; use variants/index.json for incomplete rescues
notes: The all-three group image is used by Exchange only. Rewind uses rescue masks 0–6; mask 7 selects the seven-frame Exchange ending.

frames.caption: The screen gives way. Small hands reach through the glass.
Luka, 1989. Maja, 1994. Tina, 2003. None of them a day older.
Outside, it is not their Halloween anymore.
Her mother still recognizes the costume.
The VCR clicks. Something is rewinding.
